criteria.description: Nav renders an always-visible relay connection indicator near the auth controls.
The indicator maps idle and disconnected to Disconnected, discovering and connecting to Connecting, syncing and bootstrapping to Syncing, live to Live, and error to Error.
Clicking the indicator expands details containing relay count/list, last event time, and last EOSE time.
Error state exposes the relay error message through the trigger tooltip and expanded details.
